rows.grounds: compound of laghu (light, minor) and pāpa (sin); locative sense indicating circumstance

items.question: What severity of punishment is appropriate even for a minor transgression?
premises: A transgression may be minor in nature.
Punishment can be prescribed even for minor transgressions.
The prescribed punishment in such cases is severe.
items.inference: Even a minor sin warrants severe punishment.
uncertainties: The compound laghu+pāpe is taken as a locative tatpuruṣa indicating circumstance; alternative compound readings are possible.
items.plain_english: Even for a light sin, severe punishment is prescribed.
